# gha-lint

> Estimate the billable minutes of GitHub Actions workflows and lint them for token permissions, unpinned actions and script injection. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u084-gha-lint`, package `ghalint`, MIT licensed, Go >= 1.23, one non-standard dependency: go.yaml.in/yaml/v3.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
